provenance.names: relic display names retained from the community snapshot pinned above
provenance.pools: BUG-26. Each RelicMap row lists THREE GemBall grades, not one. Everkai previously shipped only the grade-1 pool per area, leaving 22 of its 45 relics unreachable. All three pools per area are now imported from GemGacha -> split_reward/reward.json.
provenance.gemGrades: RelicLevel.json GemBall1/2/3 are the per-Steeltooth-level weights (out of 10000) for which grade a dug gemstone is. Grade 3 is zero below Steeltooth level 8. Everkai rolls the grade at appraisal instead of at dig time: the distribution is identical for a fixed level and it needs no save-shape change.
provenance.effects: BUG-27. Restoration used to pay an invented flat +1 gold/s. The original pays no gold at all: each exhibit carries a levelUpSkill typed prop (Exhibit.levelUpSkill -> SkillBase), and the museum’s only hourly payout is MuseumLevel.rewardHour, which pays Item_ExhibitEXP_* (Reward_MuseumLv0..50), not gold. Effect value = skillProp_Initial + exhibitLevel_above_1 * skillProp_Level.
provenance.adaptations: Everkai keeps its own 20-step restoration ladder at level+1 duplicate materials (the original runs 120 steps priced in ExhibitEXP currency Everkai does not have). Exhibit level = 1 + restorationLevel, so a displayed unrestored relic already pays skillProp_Initial. Faction/rarity scoped talents are applied to every Fellow because Everkai models no faction or per-Fellow rarity; the original condition is preserved per relic under effectSource.condition.
provenance.unmodelled: 36 non-part relics: 8 map onto museumBonus.aptitude; the other 28 carry props with no Everkai channel and are recorded verbatim with effectNote instead of being approximated.
